description: This file defines a mock class GstSrcMock for unit testing, which implements the IGstSrc interface. It includes mock methods for initializing the source, setting up and adding app sources, and confirming all app sources are added. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is used for testing the GstSrc component in the Rialto media server project.
